	WHEN SUBSTRING (ECD.ORGKEY, 1, 1) IN ('R','P') 
	THEN 'RETAIL'
	WHEN SUBSTRING (ECD.ORGKEY, 1, 1) IN ('C','B') 
	THEN 'CORPORATE'
	END AS CUSTOMER_TYPE
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM EDD
INNER JOIN (SELECT DateSk, FullDate, Previous_Business_Day, Month_End
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM DD
WHERE DD.FULLDATE = CAST(@Datetoprocess AS DATE)) EEC 
ON EDD.FullDate = EEC.FullDate
INNER JOIN EDS.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN LAAS
ON LAAS.AS_OF_DATE = EDD.FULLDATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.LOAN_FACT ELF
	ON LAAS.ACID = ELF.GAM_ACID
	AND LAAS.BANK_ID = ELF.GAM_BANK_ID
	AND LAAS.AS_OF_DATE = ELF.AS_OF_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.LNS_LAACCTMAST LAM
	ON LAAS.ACID = LAM.ACID
	AND LAAS.BANK_ID = LAM.BANK_ID
	AND LAAS.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN LAM.SCD_START_DATE AND LAM.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
	ON LAAS.CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID
	AND LAAS.BANK_ID = ECD.BANK_ID
	AND LAAS.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
WHERE EEC.FullDate IS NOT NULL
